# Lines.FromBinary

```m
Lines.FromBinary(binary as binary, optional quoteStyle as any, optional includeLineSeparators as nullable logical, optional encoding as nullable number) as list
```

Converts a binary value to a list of text values split at lines breaks. If a quote style is specified, then line breaks may appear within quotes. If includeLineSeparators is true, then the line break characters are included in the text.

*Description: Microsoft, MIT ([THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](../../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md)).*

Reference: [Microsoft Learn](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powerquery-m/lines-frombinary)

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Optional |
|---|---|---|
| `binary` | `binary` | no |
| `quoteStyle` | `any` | yes |
| `includeLineSeparators` | `nullable logical` | yes |
| `encoding` | `nullable number` | yes |
